evidence_summary: Primary Ewing-sarcoma work supports a secreted CALCB signal through a RAMP1-containing CGRP receptor complex, while receptor-pharmacology work shows that RAMP composition changes family-B receptor coupling; the public CALCR:RAMP composite rows do not resolve the exact CALCRL/CALCR core topology.
limitations: Retain CALCB/RAMP1 and receptor-complex evidence as a bounded route; do not promote CALCR:RAMP1/2/3 as one exact binary receptor topology or infer identical signaling across RAMP compositions.
